messages:
alice: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have 3 alert families driving most night churn. Need clear owners + short timelines so we can close the remediation loop. Summary: paging on `mgr-node OOM`, `model-queue-depth spike`, and `redis-throttle` flaps. @oncall-bot can you post the last 7d signal snapshot?

oncall-bot: Snapshot (last 7d): mgr-node_oom: 42 alerts, model_queue_spike: 78 alerts, redis_throttle: 35 alerts. Top affected services: inference-runtime, batch-ingest. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/snapshots/1728504321

ben: thanks. I propose we split: carla takes model-queue, dinesh takes redis, alice owns mgr-node OOM remediation plan. anyone opposed? :+1:

carla: I can own model-queue. Plan: add a leaky-bucket rate limiter in front of the batch scheduler + alert threshold adjustment. Target: lab PR by Tue EOD, canary config Wed night.

dinesh: I'll take redis-throttle. Likely fixes: tune client-side retry jitter, increase conn pool to hot paths, and add a dedupe on the alert rule for identical trace keys. I'll aim for infra PR by Wed.

alice: I'll handle mgr-node OOM. Short term: suppress paging under low-cpu-util conditions, raise threshold for swapped pages, add dedupe window 15m. Long term: node sizing + OOM cgroup investigation. Target: suppression + dedupe config PR by Wed EOD.

ben: can we be explicit about monitoring windows? request: 72h post-deploy monitoring and a quick sanity checklist for oncall.

carla: agreed. for model-queue I'll add a canary with `batch-size=50` and `burst=200` flag, and a Grafana dash with 1m/5m metrics.

alice: adding runbook changes as well. I'll update the runbook with the suppression rules and the rollback steps. Runbook link to edit: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alert-dedupe (please drop PR link when ready).

ben: assigning reminders: I'll create a recurring status check in the postmortem ticket for daily updates until 72h after last change. Can we include a tiny automated test to verify dedupe window? Something like:```yaml
- name: dedupe-smoke
  steps:
    - fire: fake-alert same-key x3
    - expect: 1 pager within 10m
```

carla: nice, I'll wire that into the CI smoke harness.

dinesh: for redis I'll also add an alert tag `owner=dinesh` and adjust paging policy: move to only-page-for-critical on weekdays overnight for now. We'll monitor false negatives.

alice: timeline recap: PRs by Wed EOD (carla, dinesh, alice). Canary/Config rollout Wed night/Thu early. 72h monitoring window after last rollout. ben to open the follow-up ticket and add daily check-ins.

ben: done — ticket opened: https://redwood.internal/pm/tickets/RI-9854. I'll ping here each morning with short status.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: daily check-in at 09:00 UTC until 1728580000 (end of 72h window).

carla: quick Q — do we want to change dedupe window to 30m or 15m for model-queue? leaning 15m to avoid masking real regressions.

alice: prefer 15m for now. If we still get too noisy we'll iterate to 30m but keep strong monitoring.

dinesh: +1 15m. Also I'll add a note in the runbook about signal correlation so we can detect retries vs distinct failures.

ben: thanks all. small ask — include a one-line status in the daily check message (e.g., "carla: canary OK, dinesh: infra PR open, alice: suppression merged") so oncall can triage quickly.

carla: will do.

alice: will update runbook PR with merge commit when done.

(1728504321 thread closed for edits)
